interior_speed_screen.rule: a candidate is admissible only while its peak open-cell seed speed stays within the maximum the frozen reference family (C0/C1/C2) itself produces in the same cases; the ceiling is measured here and is not adjustable, and an inadmissible seed invalidates any flux, approach or event comparison derived from its flow field
